description: Add one consumer phone number to the allowlist. Returns the created {id, consumer_phone_number}. The allowlist only takes effect while ai_audience is ALLOWLISTED_ONLY; under EVERYONE the agent answers all consumers regardless of this list.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

consumer_phone_number.description: Consumer's WhatsApp number in E.164 format, e.g. +15551234567.

name: mba_add_allowlist_entry
title: Add an allowlisted number
